source: The version number should not be interpreted as a sequence of different attention definitions. The family preserves the central goal of efficient attention evaluation while adapting scheduling and numerical paths to newer hardware.
zh: 版本号不应被解释为不同注意力定义的序列。该系列保留了高效注意力评估的中心目标，同时调整调度和数值路径以适应更新的硬件。
